summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream source rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics and revenue attribution remain incomplete; $4.92 aggregate commission is unattributed and site-attributed commission is $0. Do not claim certification, ROI, or site-attributed revenue.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, alert identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture existing consent, withdrawal, GA4 property, data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures.

Compliance, data-quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Incomplete telemetry is not a general growth blocker, but no new tracking, monetization, regulated or age-sensitive use, unsupported claims, rights-dependent content, or platform-policy expansion is approved. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional on preserving existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, and platform-policy boundaries. Keep aggregate revenue unattributed and do not treat missing analytics as zero.

Private-site decision: keep SearchWoot private. No public exposure, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, deployment, configuration or credential change, external outreach, or spend is authorized. Continue only bounded read-only evidence work and internal draft preparation. Human counsel must review upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and any future affiliate or advertising use before the owner considers a different launch disposition.
